source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Gloda post-compaction path tests idBasedHeader == null to delete stale indexed IDs. Returning false for a missing header bypassed that case and logged a misleading warning. Bugzilla discussion indicates this likely predated the compaction rewrite, even though it was noticed during its testing.
title: Use null for absent Gloda headers during compaction
